[quote=enkia;60018420][size=150]THE TREATY OF NESTOR ISLAND AS SIGNED BY [nation]Enkia[/nation] AND [nation]Sikirsk[/nation][/size]

The High Council of Covens and the ruling government of Sikirsk wish to put aside any and all previous differences and grievances aside, and in this document seeks to rectify said grievances while also furthering the economic benefit of all nations involved. The following articles have been drafted and debated upon, and both nations fully accept and agree to, with the acceptance and approval of all peoples.
This Treaty shall be a major step forward in an era of progress for all the people of Nestor Island, as this allows for more free trade and expansion for both nations as Enkia seeks to cover more ground for its people, and Sikirsk searches for more allies as the war intensifies.
 This Document was signed on July 28th, 2025 in the Enkian Capital of Astarte, in the Astaroth Pyramid Assembly building. 

[b]ARTICLE 1[/b]
As issued via telegram on the 20th of July;
"Sikirsk hereby seeks reserves of "iron" from Enkia, to be supplied via military vehicles, and delivered by military personnel. This practice is to be followed by both nations to ensure the safety and security of our transactions." The following terms were amended by the nation of Enkia in another telegram; "In exchange for this mutual share, a seceding of land  equal to 94,450 square kilometers (3,778 pixels) south of Nestor-Sikirsk. With the assurance that our new coast line will be defended and maintained."
On the 28th of July, these terms were agreed upon by both nations. The new borders await international approval, and will see Enkia become a coastal nation. Further, Enkia has made provisions to allow the Sikirskians 4 year visas to sell their homes and return to Nestor Sikirsk or Sikirsk with all travel expenses paid for, as well as being willing to purchase any remaining homes for current market value at the exact time of purchase. A private real estate agency of Enkian Blood also put out a special loan for low income sirkiskians, offering them housing cost assistance in their homeland.

[b]ARTICLE 2[/b]
In a further telegram on july 22nd the following article was laid by the sikirskian leadership;
"As stewards on both ends of this island, an alliance of nations is in order. To ensure mutual protection, economic growth and prosperity amongst our people. Further, an oath to no aggressive acts on either side must be made, to ensure peace on Nestor Island." Enkia agreed to these terms earnestly, and orders to de-arm and open the north border will be made on the signing of this treaty that the article is a part of. Further; Should either the nation of Sikirsk or Enkia break the non aggression pact, the victim is legally responsible to seek international help in condemning the perpetrator as a War Criminal.

[b]ARTICLE 3[/b]
In further pledges of support, Enkia will no longer use the name 'Enestor' to refer to the island, adopting the Sikirskian name of "Nestor Island" in all official documentation as of July 28th, 2025. A new natural gas pipeline connecting the Berith Natural Gas Line, into the sikirskian network. sikirskians may also apply for dual citizenship in Enkia. Travel between the nations we feel should be free to flow. As this conflict grows we shall also be sending arms and ammunition to the brave soldiers of Sikirsk who fight to defend Nestor Island. Further, we openly condemn and embargo all nations who have declared war on Sikirsk. For all our Nation's life Nestor-Sikirsk has been by our side, and now we stand by theirs. They have as much right to be here as we do, and as Satan and all the Demons in Hell as our witnesses, We shall defend their right to exist, and defend our island until the last blade of grass has died in Enkia. Plans and actions will be considered and developed to further support Sikirsk in protecting themselves from aggressive nations. This will include strengthening our own military, and forming new branches as this new land affords us opportunities to do so. This new Era for our Nations shall be one of mutual growth and help. By working together, Nestor Island will become a world class destination, and all shall feel the beautiful light of Humanity in Co-operation. We hope this to be an example of the unity that can be achieved through diplomacy rather than violence.

Signed by
The High Priest Malchadorus Fione and the High Council of Covens.
The Sikirskian leadership.

[b]SANV Kakhard completes renovations, oldest Srpkan ship in service[/b]

The SANV (Srpkan Armed Naval Vessel) Kakhard has completed its final renovation and testing and is now coming out of retirement. Built in 1942, this battlecruiser saw no direct military action in any front, however, it was decided that the ship would not be scrapped, but instead used for experiments, testing if ships of those era could indeed be used in modern warfare.
Image of ship: https://imgur.com/a/N0Z7tul

The battlecruiser has been given the following enhancements
- A nuclear reactor has been constructed to power the Kakhard in replacement of coal-powered engines
- Anti-submarine rockets and BMD (Ballistic Missile Defense) have been installed
-The anti-aircraft guns have been updated for modern warfare
-The main batteries are going to be fed 9 inch modern high explosive shells for bombarding coastal targets
-The Kakhard will be tested on a cargo ship sent for scrapping as practice. More systems like Phalanx will be installed after testing, but the battlecruiser is officially military-worthy
